title: MLOps Team 20 - Turkish Music Emotion
summary: An MLOps pipeline project for classifying emotions in Turkish music using acoustic features, built with cookiecutter-data-science structure, DVC, and MLflow tooling. Its test suite uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with a Metadata object to generate synthetic acoustic feature data for testing the training and prediction pipelines.
